final: WITH j AS (SELECT o.weathprofile AS w, t.bandusagepct AS b FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.detecttempk >= 152.1), g AS (SELECT w, AVG(b) AS a, COUNT(*) AS n FROM j GROUP BY w) SELECT w AS weathprofile, a AS avg_bandusagepct, n AS telescope_count, a - (SELECT AVG(a) FROM g) AS diff_from_mean_of_avgs FROM g WHERE (SELECT AVG(a) FROM g) IS NOT NULL
